[[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] '''Renerdat''' oversaw [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] operation on [[Sevetta/Legends|Sevetta]], acquiring and studying captured [[Polydroxol]]s. Two of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] under his supervision were [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] [[Trem DeSelvaine]] and [[Sera (scientist)|Sera]].<ref name="SS" />
